meaning_of_null: Unknown, not zero; do not calculate personal final net profit until applicable missing inputs have evidence.

fields.name: usable_capital
fields.evidence: Operator declaration; hypothetical 5000 is not an account balance

fields.name: spot_fee_per_side
fields.evidence: Actual account tier, maker/taker rule, discounts and fee currency

fields.name: perpetual_fee_per_side
fields.evidence: Actual account tier and fee schedule

fields.name: margin_rules
fields.unit: collateral currency, tier, maintenance fraction and liquidation fee
fields.evidence: Applicable venue/account rules at evaluation time

fields.name: fill_and_latency
fields.evidence: Authorized execution records; public book quotes are not fills

fields.name: infrastructure_and_development
fields.unit: currency and amount per month, plus one-time development
fields.evidence: Operator costs with allocation period; avoid double counting sunk development

fields.name: entry_exit_transfers_and_gas
fields.evidence: Actual route and fee assumptions; no transfers authorized

fields.name: fiat_conversion
fields.unit: BRL per USDT/USDC with spread and timestamp
fields.evidence: Executable route and separate stablecoin risks; never assume parity

fields.name: tax_and_reporting_cost
fields.unit: applicable jurisdiction, basis, currency and period
fields.evidence: Operator-specific information and current qualified guidance

fields.name: maximum_acceptable_loss
fields.evidence: Operator decision, not inferred from hypothetical research

available_now: Historical hypothetical cost scenarios and break-even sensitivities remain valid within their declared assumptions. Do not sum scenarios sharing the same capital.
